settings.text: Equip your heavy-duty facility with Swarakshit to maintain industrial safety compliance and easily detect combustible gas leaks.

settings.heading: Bring SWARAKSHIT Into Your Plant
settings.text: Industrial facilities require rigorous safety measures. The Swarakshit Gas Leak Tester helps floor managers and safety officers run routine checks for combustible gas leaks around heavy machinery, large storage tanks, complex pipeline networks, and industrial burners. Robust, rechargeable, and built to support your daily factory safety protocols.
settings.author: ~ Swarakshit Industrial Safety

settings.title: Routine Pipeline Inspections
settings.description: A heavy-duty, portable gas monitor for floor managers performing daily or weekly leak inspections around high-pressure pipelines, industrial valves, and localized storage areas.

settings.title: Safety Officer Patrols
settings.description: Equip your safety officers with a highly sensitive, portable device. The 8-10 hour battery life ensures continuous monitoring during long shifts and expansive factory patrols.

settings.title: Multi-Point Compliance
settings.description: Easily check for leaks across sprawling plants and multiple production lines. Swarakshit detects LPG, PNG, CNG, and methane, providing an essential tool for your compliance toolkit.
